Free evidence access · optional member support

MEMBERSHIP.

The underlying public-source evidence is available to Free Members. Paid tiers are optional monthly donations for people who want added curation, delivery, monitoring, exports, research tools and member services.

Evidence boundary: public records, source documents and evidence routes remain open to examination. Membership does not turn allegations into facts, guarantee that requested records exist, or promise a particular conclusion.

Evidence access promise

THE EVIDENCE IS FREE. DONATIONS FUND THE MACHINE.

Free Member access includes the same underlying public-source evidence used by Supporter, Intelligence Member and Research Pro.

Higher levels do not purchase a superior version of the truth or unlock hidden evidence. They provide added convenience: curated briefings, more frequent delivery, watchlists, source-change monitoring, downloadable formats, advanced filters, research workflow tools and member support.
